objective: Identify actual incoming task-asset references and internal dependencies for explicit retirement

semantic_brief.summary: Pure reference projection for task deletion; external references must preserve original source, internal dependencies propagate if their consumer is kept.

acceptance: Expose scan_task_references(repo, change, targets) returning external, internal, baselines, errors maps; no mutation or deletion
Targets maps runId to record, roots (absolute work root plus archive file paths), files (absolute owned file paths); only current index/declared sources establish ownership
External logical test-assets refs must retain target Run even when archive exists; physical aliases and directory ancestors also count

Separate self documents under changes/TARGET from incoming repo plans/WorkItems and other Change indexes; parse all registered consumer JSON using old binding or temporary archive unpack, never restore

Return internal sourceRun -> targetRuns edges for self-task Run provenance; formal baseline and original-source protection tracked; malformed/unknown incoming data produces errors rather than empty success
Use existing public test seams with isolated owned fixtures, RED then GREEN; do not run .NET or real model/device
forbidden: Modify metadata/indexes of real repo tasks or delete files
Stage/commit/push, rewrite sealed evidence or add generic reference platform
